jobs.description: Looking for a stable logistics job where you can make a difference every day? Do you enjoy working in a warehouse environment and operating a reachtruck? Are you accurate, safety-conscious, and motivated to keep logistics processes running smoothly? Then this opportunity at Bakeplus could be exactly what you're looking for. As a Reachtruck Driver, you will be responsible for moving, storing, and replenishing goods throughout the warehouse. You will work closely with your colleagues to ensure that customer orders are processed efficiently and delivered on time. Wat ga je doen? As a Reachtruck Driver, you play an important role in the daily logistics operation. Your responsibilities include: Operating a reach truck safely and efficiently Storing and retrieving pallets from warehouse racks Replenishing picking locations Loading and unloading incoming goods Checking products for quality, damage, and shelf life Supporting order picking and other warehouse activities when needed Maintaining a safe and organized workplace Working hours: Monday - Thursday: 07:00 - 16:30 Friday: 07:00 - 13:30 You will work in different warehouse zones, including ambient, refrigerated, and freezer areas, making every workday varied and challenging. Wat kun jij? Valid reach truck certificate and experience operating a reach truck Good understanding of warehouse processes You are reliable, accurate, and safety-conscious You enjoy working independently as well as in a team You are physically fit and willing to support other warehouse activities when necessary You speak Dutch or English Wat krijg je? At Bakeplus, you're more than just an employee. You'll join a family-owned company where teamwork, respect, and a positive work atmosphere are highly valued. In return, you can expect: Hourly wage of €16.71 gross Freezer allowance of €1.28 per hour Holiday allowance and vacation days Travel allowance of €0.23 per km A stable full-time position with long-term opportunities Opportunities for personaldevelopment and career growth A friendly and informal working environment with short communication lines Bakeplus is a leading supplier for professional bakeries and pastry businesses. The company combines quality, service, and innovation with a family-oriented culture where employees are valued and supported. Working at Bakeplus means becoming part of a close-knit team that strives for the best results together.

English speaking Are willing to work in a two-shift system: 06:00 – 15:00 / 15:00 – 00:00 Are comfortable working in a cooled production environment Are willing to work on Saturdays and public holidays when required Wat bieden wij je? As a Production Employee, you’ll be part of the packing department and work together with your team to keep the production line running smoothly. No problem! You’ll receive proper training and guidance from experienced colleagues. You’ll learn the job step by step and become more confident as you go. Whether you already have production experience or are completely new to the industry, DeliBarn gives you the opportunity to learn, gain experience and build a future within the company. Apply today and start your new job at DeliBarn in Wijchen.
